# Piper Alba attribution

Piper engine 1.8.0: [OHF-Voice/piper1-gpl](https://github.com/OHF-Voice/piper1-gpl), GPL-3.0; installed COPYING preserved beside this file. HARMONY imports the installed library through an original supervised adapter; upstream engine code was not copied into the application. Packaging still requires the complete applicable source/notices inventory.

Model: [rhasspy/piper-voices, en_GB-alba-medium](https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/blob/c10ece1aade47bb51c153c893d14e5bf8e5b7117/en/en_GB/alba/medium/MODEL_CARD). Original model/config bytes are unchanged; medium-quality, single-speaker, 22,050 Hz. The model card lists CC BY 4.0 for its dataset and records finetuning from the US lessac medium voice. That training history is preserved.

Dataset attribution: Valentini-Botinhao, Cassia; Yamagishi, Junichi (2019), *Alba speech corpus*, University of Edinburgh, [doi:10.7488/ds/2506](https://doi.org/10.7488/ds/2506). The [dataset record](https://datashare.ed.ac.uk/handle/10283/3270) describes a Scottish-accented female speaker. [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). No endorsement is implied. No original recordings were downloaded; only the published model and its metadata were provisioned.
